event_name: Date 08 April 2018 Time 22:30 2018 BAHRAIN GRAND PRIX 5 - 8 April 2018 The Stewards The Stewards, having received a report from the Race Director, summoned (document 30) and heard the team representatives, have considered the following matter and determine the following
fact: Car 7 was released unsafely from a pit stop.
offence: Breach of Article 28.13 a) of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
reason: The Stewards reviewed the video of the pit stop of Raikkonen at 19:10 and heard from the team representatives. The Stewards determined that the car was released unsafely in breach of Art. 28.13 a). The team released the car in a manner endangering team personnel and causing injury. Gerd Ennser Paolo Longoni Danny Sullivan Mazen Al Hilli
title: 2018 Bahrain Grand Prix 2018 Offence Ferrari Unsafe Release Of Car 7 From A Pitstop Doc 35
